title: Balanced Brackets
description:
A string contains only the characters ( ) [ ] { }. It is balanced when every opening bracket is closed by the same kind of bracket, and brackets close in the opposite order to which they opened.

Print YES if the string is balanced and NO otherwise.

Input format
One line containing the string.

Output format
YES or NO.
hints: Think about which opening bracket must be closed first when you meet a closing bracket.
The most recently opened bracket must be closed first: that is last-in, first-out, the behaviour of a stack.
Push every opening bracket. For a closing bracket, the stack must be non-empty and its top must be the matching opener; pop it. At the end the stack must be empty.

examples.explanation: Every bracket is closed in the correct order.
The ( is still open when ] arrives, so the order is wrong.
